tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender bid document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: List of Items supplies along with Users certificate:-Performance to be furnished by the OEM for the full tendered quantity as specified in the Schule of requirements. In case of Authorized bidders should submit 80% performance for similar products as specified in schedule of requirements along OEM performance of 100 % as per proforma given in section XIII and Proof of performance to be submitted in the form of purchase order/Supply order and tax invoice copies.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- List of Items supplies along with Users certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PAN Card :PAN Card of the Firm/Tenderer is to be uploaded in original.

Manufacturing License: a).Manufacturing License, duly renewed up to date along with list of products permitted is to be uploaded in original, if Tenderer is a Manufacturer. If Tenderer is an Authorized Agent/Distributor should upload the Notarized copy of Manufacturers Manufacturing License. or b).Registration (if bidder is a company) by registration of Companies document to be up loaded in original. or c).The Importer License, renewed up to date along with list of items permitted (Items to be quoted) is to be uploaded if Tenderer is an Authorized Importer. Along with copy of the authorization by the foreign manufacturer and a copy of the Registration of the Foreign manufacturer in its country is to be uploaded in original.d) Valid SSI Certificate, issued by Director of Industries Commerce, Government of Karnataka is to be uploaded in original, by SSI units of Karnataka otherwise they will not treated as SSI units of Karnataka.

Manufacturers Authorization Certificate: Authorization Certificate from original Manufacturer is to be uploaded in original from reputed Manufacturers, if Tenderer is an Principle Authorized Agent/Distributor and Licensed Authorized Importer as per Section-XIV. The Sub-Agents/Sub-Distributors are not eligible.

Tender Offer Form-Part I: Tender Offer Form with an undertaking to abide by the terms and conditions of the tender in the format as per Section-IX-Part-, of the Tenderer is to be uploaded in original.

Declaration From-Part II:Declaration from the Tenderer in the format as per Section IX-Part-II of the Tenderer is to be uploaded in original. On on a Rs.200/- stamp paper: by the authorized signatory undertaking that 1) They agree to abide by the conditions of the tender. 2) The firm is not blacklisted by the Government of any State in India or Government of India. 3 The Tenderer undertakes to extend warranty and free service as per the tender conditions

List of Furnitures quoted under this Tender: List of Furnitures along with Manufacturer/s Name, Country of origin and Model name and number quoted by the tenderer should be clearly furnished separately as per Section-XVII, is to be uploaded in original.

Annual Turn-Over Statement: a) Annual Turnover Must be 30 lakhs statement for proceeding three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 i.e., for 31-03-2024 31-03-2025 & 31.03.2026 of the Tenderer as per Section-XV Certified by Commercial Tax Officer/Charted Accountant is to be uploaded in original with UDIN No. b) Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Statements for preceding 3 years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 to be uploaded
ITR RETURNS:-Income Tax Returns ITR for the last Three Financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 with Balance Sheet in original should be uploaded duly certified by the -Chartered Accountant.
